title: PS Portal Player: Sony's new Portal adds storage 🎮
subject: psportal
description:
Would you buy a Portal with storage? 👇

Sony announced the PlayStation Portal Player on November 9, 2026, a Japan-only update to the PS Portal with internal storage for future functionality Sony has not explained yet. It launches in Japan on December 10, 2026 for ¥39,980, with pre-orders from November 13. No release outside Japan has been announced.

Sources: PlayStation Blog Japan via Push Square (Nov 9, 2026), Kotaku (Nov 9, 2026), tbreak (Nov 10, 2026)

scenes.text: Sony just announced a new PlayStation Portal, only for Japan.
scenes.search: handheld game console streaming close up

scenes.text: It's called the PlayStation Portal Player, without the word Remote.
scenes.search: gamer holding handheld console dark room

scenes.text: The big change is internal storage. Sony hasn't said how much, or what it's for.
It only promises future functionality, explained later. For now, it still streams from a PS5 or the cloud.
It arrives December 10 for 39,980 yen, the same price as today's model.
Pre-orders open November 13, with no release announced outside Japan.
